title: Did anyone else ever have a dream so strong that it affects you in the real world
content: I had this dream that I was in my bedroom standing in front of a mirror while holding a candle but the light outside flickered like something was trying to cover the sun and when it went dark my reflection started to smile wider and wider and could only watch as the mirror opened and my reflection stabbed me with glass shards but as I woke up I had scars I didn’t have before
